about.title: About Meridian Build Group
about.subtitle: Engineering Excellence Since 1974
about.story: For over five decades, Meridian Build Group has been at the forefront of global construction innovation. From iconic skyscrapers to critical infrastructure, we transform ambitious visions into enduring landmarks.
about.missionText: To deliver world-class construction solutions that exceed expectations through innovation, integrity, and uncompromising quality.
about.visionText: To be the most trusted construction partner globally, shaping skylines and communities for generations to come.
about.pageSubtitle: A legacy of excellence in construction and engineering
about.historyText: Founded in 1974, Meridian Build Group began as a regional contractor and has grown into a global powerhouse with operations across 12 countries. Our portfolio includes award-winning commercial towers, sustainable residential communities, and mission-critical infrastructure.
about.globalReachText: With offices in Europe, North America, and the Middle East, we bring local expertise with global standards to every project.

ceo.title: Message from Our CEO
ceo.quote: At Meridian Build Group, we don't just construct buildings — we build the foundations of progress. Every project is a commitment to excellence, safety, and the communities we serve.
ceo.name: Alexander Hartmann
